BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to protecting the state's cultural resources; andadding a new section to chapter 43.21C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Decisions listed in subsection (2) of this section are subjectto the requirements of RCW 43.21C.030(2)(c) pertaining to culturalresources in effect as of July 1, 2012. (2) This section applies to decisions pertaining to proposedactions that were subject to the requirements of RCW 43.21C.030(2)(c)as of July 1, 2012, but made exempt from the requirements: (a) Through rule making conducted pursuant to section 301, chapter1, Laws of 2012 1st sp. sess.; (b) Pursuant to section 304(1)(a)(iii), chapter 1, Laws of 2012 1stsp. sess. (codified as RCW 43.21C.229(1)(a)(iii)); (c) Pursuant to section 307, chapter 1, Laws of 2012 1st sp. sess.(codified as RCW 43.21C.450); or p. 1 HB 2709 (d) Pursuant to other statutes enacted or rules adopted on or afterJuly 1, 2012.
